text: CREATE TABLE identity_provider (tenant_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id), protocol text NOT NULL CHECK (protocol IN ('SAML 2.0','OpenID Connect')), sso_url text NOT NULL CHECK (sso_url ~ '^https://'), issuer text NOT NULL, domain text NOT NULL, domain_verified boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, breakglass_email text, enforced boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, mfa_policy text NOT NULL, max_session_hours int NOT NULL CHECK (max_session_hours BETWEEN 1 AND 24), idle_minutes int NOT NULL CHECK (idle_minutes BETWEEN 5 AND 120), CHECK (NOT enforced OR (domain_verified AND breakglass_email IS NOT NULL)));            -- ENT-IDN-02/06
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)

text: CREATE TABLE scim_token (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id), token_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), token_hash bytea NOT NULL, prefix text NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), revoked_at timestamptz);
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)

text: CREATE TABLE custom_role (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES tenant(tenant_id), role_id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name text NOT NULL, UNIQUE (tenant_id, name));
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)

text: CREATE TABLE role_permission (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, role_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES custom_role(role_id), permission text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission));
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)

text: CREATE TABLE sod_conflict (permission_a text, permission_b text, PRIMARY KEY (permission_a, permission_b));
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)

text: INSERT INTO sod_conflict VALUES ('Runs:create','Runs:approve'),('Configuration:edit','Configuration:approve'),('Billing:view','Billing:approve'),('Runs:approve','Runs:dispatch');
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)

text: CREATE FUNCTION enforce_sod() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_permission rp JOIN sod_conflict c ON (c.permission_a = NEW.permission AND c.permission_b = rp.permission) OR (c.permission_b = NEW.permission AND c.permission_a = rp.permission) WHERE rp.role_id = NEW.role_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'separation of duties violation: % conflicts within role', NEW.permission; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;
sec: Appendix C2 — Enterprise schema additions (PostgreSQL, proposed)
